title: How We Should Vote (Range Voting)
summary: A six-minute explainer from Undefined Behavior on range (score) voting. It follows an earlier video on Arrow's Theorem and shows how range voting seems to satisfy the criteria Arrow's Theorem says no ranked system can.
why: HN commenters link it in voting-reform discussions as a concise explanation of range voting versus other systems.
